outcomes.text: Identify and understand factual information, ideas and arguments in varied texts.
Identify and understand ideas, opinions and attitudes, including how they connect across texts.
Understand implied meanings, including unstated purposes, opinions, attitudes and feelings.
Work out the meaning of unfamiliar words and phrases using surrounding information and inference.
Select relevant details by applying skimming, scanning, careful reading and question-focused prediction strategies.
Communicate factual information, ideas and arguments clearly, developing them with appropriate detail.
Produce accurate written texts demonstrating control of grammar, vocabulary, punctuation and spelling.
Select and organise relevant information and ideas coherently, using suitable linking devices and paragraphing.
Produce writing using varied grammatical and lexical structures while avoiding unnecessary repetition.
Respond appropriately to written stimuli by using suitable register, style and format for purpose and audience.
Identify and understand factual details and specific information in varied spoken contexts and sources.
Identify and understand speakers’ ideas, opinions, feelings and attitudes in varied spoken contexts.
Understand connections between speakers’ ideas, opinions, feelings and attitudes in spoken texts.
Understand implied meanings, including unstated purposes, intentions, attitudes and feelings.
Deduce unfamiliar word or phrase meanings from surrounding spoken information and inference.
